quote: We present PLOTMACHINES, a novel narrative transformer that simulates the outline-conditioned generation process described above. Our model learns to transform an outline into a multiparagraph story using dynamic memory blocks that keep track of the implicit plot states computed using the outline and the story generated thus far.
